Q5558.reason: Oedema is excess fluid in the interstitial/extravascular space, not inside vessels, the cranium, or necrotic tissue.

Q5561.reason: Alcohol is the drug most often behind acute confusional presentations, far ahead of opiates, ecstasy, or cannabis.

Q5562.reason: Cutting senior admission to 50 cents prevents the pledged $2-per-ticket bond repayment and so impairs the state's own contract; it is not criminal ex post facto or an equal-protection violation.
